body: A settings/GPO disable can race this startup enable. `effective()` is checked before the awaited RPC, while `SessionAttached` is emitted only afterward. If the runtime update arrives during that await, `apply_runtime_yolo_config` sees no live session and queues an empty reconciliation; this RPC can then leave Copilot native `allow_all` enabled even though the shared state (or policy) is off. Re-check the effective state after the enable completes and synchronously undo it (triggering fail-closed restart on failure), or serialize session creation with runtime reconciliation.

body: The implementation now defines provider-native contracts for Claude (and below, Codex/Gemini), while ordinary permission requests remain interactive. This contradicts the PR description's “Copilot-native only; all other agents use AllowOnce fallback” approval paths. The code and design spec agree with each other, so update the PR description to describe the implemented security model before merge.

This does not enforce the documented exact Copilot contract requiring both `on` and `off`: when the current value is another advertised value, `{on, current}` is accepted even if `off` is absent. Since this enables a high-risk provider mode, require the configured restore value as part of capability validation.

The PR description promises `session/request_permission` fallback auto-approval (`AllowOnce`) for non-native/unsupported contracts, but this implementation explicitly keeps every ordinary permission request interactive and instead adds native modes for Claude, Codex, and Gemini. That materially changes the advertised behavior and title; either restore the documented fallback or update the PR description to the provider-native-only contract.

+//! This module maps master-attested built-in provider identities to exact
+//! advertised session contracts, captures restore values per session, and
+//! sequences RPCs so stale operations cannot win. The App owns desired Yolo
+//! state; ordinary permission requests always remain user-selected.
